title: The Everyday Git Rhythm
prompt:
Write a function `commitSequence()` that RETURNS an array of git commands — in order — for this situation: you just created a new project folder, and you have finished your first page and want to record it.

Include exactly: initializing the repo, checking the state, staging everything, and committing with the message "First page".
boilerplate: // commitSequence() returns the 4 git commands in order

tests.name: the four commands in order
